title: 第19章 万宝拍卖行第20章 上阵父子兵
slug: 重生本统子教宿主当老六
content_zh:
经过一下午的吸收，陆沉在承受了不小的痛苦后终于达到了开蒙境五重。
“拿着，你的奖励！”
苟系统一脸嫌弃地看着躺在地上的陆沉，将一张人皮面具丢给陆沉。
“这个要怎么用？”
陆沉一脸兴奋地打量着这新奇的物件。
“可以在系统界面捏脸哦！
不过一经确定就不能再更改了。”
说到这里，9527不禁想到前世玩游戏时的捏脸功能，据说是不少女孩子的最爱。
“要怎么捏呢？这怎么看也不像是个世外高人啊！”
陆沉站在屏幕前已经纠结了一个时辰了，仍然没有捏出一张满意的脸。
9527在一旁腹诽道：“苟宿主怎么和上辈子的某些人一样，捏个脸都要这么久。”
“苟系统，要不你来给我捏？”
陆沉尴尬地嘿嘿一笑。
“行吧，我来试试！”
苟系统撸起袖子，跃跃欲试。
随着苟系统的一通操作，一张脸算是捏完了，只见那是一张布满皱纹的老人的脸，瘦削的脸上布满岁月的痕迹，白色的山羊胡惟妙惟肖，脸上的老年斑更是恰到好处，还有一道经过左眼的刀疤更是写满了故事。
“哇，苟系统你还真有两下子啊！”
陆沉十分满意地点点头，毫不犹豫地点下了确定。
“那当然，我可是专业的。”
苟系统洋洋得意地说道，随即想到了自己上辈子的童年经常做各种手工，自己很喜欢也很有天赋。

想着想着又摇摇头，心里默念道：“我想这些干嘛，还是老老实实当我的系统好了。”
一夜无话，第二天一早陆沉就急匆匆地出门了，先是找了个没人的角落换上一身黑色长袍和斗篷，披上面具，戴上兜帽，瞬间一个饱经沧桑的老人就出现了。
“苟系统，你看看怎么样？”
陆沉兴冲冲地问，说着，眼睛睁大，惊讶地问：“我的声音怎么也变成老头了？”
苟系统得意地说道：“我早就告诉你了，这面具还能改变声音，系统出品，必属精品！”
“真厉害！”
陆沉说了一句，便向着东市最大的一栋建筑走去，而这栋庞大且豪华的建筑便是整个东域都赫赫有名的万宝阁，当然万宝阁是连锁店，乌泽城这家只能算比较小的。
陆沉走进万宝阁，那充满沧桑的气质瞬间吸引了接待人员，一名年轻店员连忙上前询问道：“老先生，请问有什么可以帮到您？”
不等陆沉开口，9527率先示范着说道：“我要出一批丹药，叫你们这里的管事的来。
现在起我怎么说你就怎么说，语气严肃一点。
记得拿一瓶赤血散给他当样品。”
陆沉眨了眨眼，用沧桑的口音说道：“我要出一批丹药，叫你们这里管事的来。”
说完从怀里取出一瓶赤血散递了过去。
content_en:
After an afternoon of absorption, Lu Chen finally reached the fifth level of enlightenment after enduring a lot of pain.
"Take it, your reward!"
System Gou looked at Lu Chen lying on the ground with disgust, and threw a human skin mask to Lu Chen.
"How to use this?"
Lu Chen looked at this novel object with excitement.
“You can pinch your face in the system interface!
However, once determined, it cannot be changed. "
Speaking of this, 9527 couldn't help but think of the face-squeezing function used in games in his previous life, which is said to be the favorite of many girls.
"How do you pinch it? No matter how you look at it, you don't look like an outsider!"
Lu Chen had been struggling in front of the screen for an hour, and still couldn't make a satisfied face.
9527 cursed from the side: "Why is it that Host Gou is like some people in the previous life, and it takes so long to pinch his face?"
"Gou System, why don't you come and pinch it for me?"
Lu Chen smiled awkwardly.
"Okay, let me try!"
Gou System rolled up his sleeves and was eager to try.
With one operation of the Gou system, a face was pinched, and it turned out to be the face of an old man full of wrinkles. The thin face was covered with traces of time, the white goatee was lifelike, the age spots on the face were just right, and there was a scar that passed through the left eye, which was full of stories.
"Wow, System Gou, you really have some tricks up your sleeve!"
Lu Chen nodded with great satisfaction and confirmed without hesitation.
"Of course, I'm a professional."
Gou System said proudly, and then thought of his previous childhood where he often did various handicrafts, which he liked very much and was very talented at.
Thinking about it, he shook his head and said to himself: "Why do I think about this? It's better to just treat it as my system."
After a night of silence, Lu Chen hurried out the next morning. He first found a deserted corner and put on a black robe and cloak, then put on a mask and a hood. In an instant, a weathered old man appeared.
"Gou System, what do you think?"
Lu Chen asked excitedly. As he spoke, his eyes widened and he asked in surprise: "Why does my voice sound like an old man's?"
System Gou said proudly: "I told you a long time ago that this mask can also change the voice. The product produced by System must be a high-quality product!"
"It's amazing!"
Lu Chen said something and walked towards the largest building in the East City. This huge and luxurious building is the Wanbao Pavilion, which is famous throughout the Eastern Region. Of course, Wanbao Pavilion is a chain store, and this one in Wuze City can only be considered a relatively small one.
Lu Chen walked into Wanbao Pavilion, and his vicissitudes of temperament instantly attracted the reception staff. A young clerk quickly stepped forward and asked: "Old sir, how can I help you?"
Before Lu Chen could speak, 9527 took the lead in demonstrating: "I'm going to produce a batch of elixirs and call your managers here.
From now on, you can say whatever I say, in a more serious tone.
Remember to give him a bottle of red blood powder as a sample. "
Lu Chen blinked and said with a vicissitudes of life accent: "I'm going to produce a batch of elixirs and ask your people in charge to come over."
After speaking, he took out a bottle of red blood from his arms and passed it around.
